attributes.board_name: Missouri State Board of Registration for the Healing Arts – Advisory Commission for Speech-Language Pathologists and Audiologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 of the 30 hours from activities/providers approved by ASHA, AAA, AMA, NCHAM, CDC, NIDCD, AAO-HNS, AAP or AAN, courses sponsored by MSHA, MAA, DESE or CEC, or regionally accredited college coursework (1 semester hour = 15 h, 1 quarter hour = 10 h). Up to 10 hours from other organized programs in basic communication processes, professional areas (incl. dysphagia) or related areas (e.g. ethics, supervision, counseling, business management). 1 hour = 50–60 minutes; 1 CEU = 10 clock hours, CEUs rounded down to whole hours. 30 days of clinical fellowship in a period satisfy that period's requirement.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Provisional licensees are exempt until a permanent license is issued.
rules.audit_note: Licensees attest under penalty of perjury on the renewal form; the Board may audit. Keep records (title, date, location, sponsor, category, hours) for at least 3 years after the reporting period.
rules.notes: CE reporting period: Jan 1 – Dec 31 of the two years before renewal (24 months); licenses expire biennially in odd-numbered years, renewals postmarked Feb 1 or later are delinquent (so due by Jan 31). Holders of both SLP and audiology licenses need 30 hours in SLP and 30 hours in audiology. Registered SLP assistants and SLP/audiology aides renew every 2 years without a CE requirement in the rules (20 CSR 2150-4.130, 4.215).
rules.rule_quote: (1) Each licensee shall biennially complete and report at least thirty (30) hours of continuing education.
